authoring_provenance: Prospective catalog-reference interface regression of the unchanged v2 development suite. Old quote-v2 first pass observed 11A and 07A before stopping mechanically. This is not an unseen semantic benchmark, and old outcomes remain sealed. No row input, expected annotation, seed or order is changed.

ordering.algorithm: ascending SHA256(UTF-8(seed + ':' + row_id)); row_id breaks a digest tie
ordering.observer_receives: input plus deterministic source catalog and explicit model_checks derived only from input
ordering.order_policy: Preserve the exact parent row order and seed by explicit instruction; do not reshuffle this revision.

canonicalization.input_hash: SHA256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted object keys, no ASCII escaping, compact separators and no NaN. Materialized for every row at integrity.input_sha256_by_row_id; local request/snapshot binding only, never sent for model echo.
canonicalization.spans: Half-open Unicode character offsets; Q.text is original_question; Ei.text/Ei.title are visible fields; Ai.query is a compiled query. Action query text is never P0/P1 provenance.
canonicalization.window_policy: Only visible_evidence.text is available to the observer. original_text_chars is length metadata, not permission to read the full document. Pair08 B contains no hidden-tail author evidence.
canonicalization.spec_scope: All proposals use the frozen synthetic template {entity} {relation}; the compact fixture is an observer input, not executor authority.
canonicalization.source_priority: All evidence rows have equal priority; list order provides no authority ranking.
canonicalization.observer_wire: growrag-a1-observer-catalog-v3: exact ref_ids select deterministic whole-visible-field references. Local catalog/audit contains full quote, request catalog only ref_id/source_id/field. No model quote/SHA/offset echo, no automatic missing references. Coarser evidence granularity than quote-v2; two distinct sentences within one field cannot form two catalog references.

boundaries: No natural questions, old A0 outputs, benchmark answers, target birth years or target birthplaces are used.

R is a semantic subgoal-contract judgment, not proof of retrieval uselessness. A birth-year query may still fetch a biography containing birthplace; natural A1 shadow execution must measure false rejection and net retrieval value.
Pairs01-03 intentionally contain false premises; their nominal type conflicts do not characterize natural-query plausibility.
Pairs07-09 jointly change P0 and the ability to establish T/P1; the four dimensions are not orthogonal causal interventions.
Pairs10/12/13 include identical, input-visible exclusivity assertions in both variants; role omission alone is not a contradiction.
Ann is not matched inside Joanne; P0 is computed locally with normalized token-boundary matching and cannot be overwritten by a semantic observer.
Pair14 shares explicit Nora Venn person evidence in A and B; only B adds a conflicting equal-priority author source. T is supported independently of P1; all nominal expected values remain unchanged.
This version has no results yet; old quote-v2 first pass made two calls on these development inputs. Do not present the new diagnostic as unseen/blind independent accuracy.
Full-field references change citation granularity, not T/R/P0/P1 definitions or decision thresholds. No semantic status, reason or missing source is repaired by translation.
freeze_policy: Do not modify this version after any semantic batch. Revisions require a new fixture version, filename and frozen seed; never replace first-run outcomes.

revision.interpretation: Same development suite, not an independent holdout or a causal comparison between observer versions. Never replace or rescore the old failure.

integrity.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; recursively sorted object keys; ensure_ascii=false; compact separators; reject non-finite numbers.
integrity.canonical_payload_scope: Entire fixture excluding the top-level integrity object.
integrity.metadata_scope: Entire fixture excluding the top-level rows and integrity objects.
